text: Sharekey Office: now available in the Desktop app (Major Feature).
Recents: new menu tab to quickly access recently added, opened, and viewed files.
Reactions: Directs and Channels move up when someone reacts to your messages.
Actions dropdown: now available on right-click in Contacts, Company, and Discover lists.
External Link: improved for Sharekey Office documents (view-only mode & download).
Message Security: strengthened with additional digital signature checks to verify message authenticity and integrity.
